1004.description: A squat with a band above the knees. It trains the glutes and thighs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, with the band placed just above your knees.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat position.
Make sure your knees are tracking over your toes and your weight is in your heels.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开站立，与肩同宽，弹力带放在膝盖上方。
保持挺胸、核心收紧，将臀部向后推，弯曲膝盖，形成下蹲姿势。
确保膝盖位于脚趾上方，并且重量位于脚后跟。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1068.description: Extend your arm back against cable resistance. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Hinge forward and hold a handle with elbow bent.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor.
Extend your arm back.
Squeeze the triceps.
Return slowly and switch sides.

1132.description: Stepping wide to the side while holding the straps works the thighs, glutes and inner legs.
instructions: Hold the handles and stand with feet together.
Step out wide to one side.
Bend that knee and push your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and heel down.
Push off to return to the start.
Alternate sides.

1196.description: Curling one dumbbell at a time while standing. A classic way to build the biceps with a steady rhythm.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbow by your side, curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it under control.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Avoid swinging your torso to lift the weight.

1260.description: A one-arm cable press from a decline angle. It trains the chest and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine to a decline position.
Stand facing away from the machine and grab the handle with one hand.
Position yourself with your back against the decline bench and your arm extended straight in front of you.
Bend your elbow and lower the handle towards your chest while keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the handle back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 将拉线机调整至下降位置。
背对机器站立，用一只手抓住手柄。
将背部靠在下斜长凳上，手臂伸直在身前。
弯曲肘部，将手柄向胸部方向降低，同时保持上臂静止。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将手柄推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1324.description: A cable row with a straight bar pulled toward your upper chest. It targets the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a cable machine at chest height.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the bar towards your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement.
Slowly release the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将直杆连接到胸部高度的缆绳机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，双手距离略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将杠铃拉向上胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢地将杠铃释放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1388.description: A seated stretch where you turn your foot to open the outer side of your lower leg. It targets the peroneal muscles beside the calf.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Loop the rope around the ball of your foot and hold the ends of the rope with your hands.
Gently pull the rope towards you, flexing your foot and stretching your calf muscles.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Release the tension on the rope and repeat the stretch on the other leg.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将绳子绕在脚掌上，并用手握住绳子的末端。
轻轻地将绳子拉向自己，弯曲脚并伸展小腿肌肉。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒。
释放绳子上的张力，然后在另一条腿上重复拉伸。
重复所需的重复次数。

1452.description: A seated machine crunch where you curl your torso toward your hips against resistance. It trains the abs with a controlled, fixed path.
instructions: Sit on the leverage machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles or place your hands on the side pads for support.
Engage your abs and slowly lean back, allowing the pad to move with you.
Once your upper body is at a 45-degree angle, contract your abs and crunch forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在杠杆机上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地板上。
抓住手柄或将手放在侧垫上以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌并慢慢向后倾斜，让垫子随着您一起移动。
一旦你的上半身呈 45 度角，收缩腹肌并向前卷腹，使胸部靠近膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1516.description: A clean started from blocks at about knee height. It trains the explosive pull and the catch without the first pull from the floor.
instructions: Set the bar on blocks and grip it just outside your knees with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a full squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

1580.description: A bodyweight squat with your hands behind your head. It keeps your chest open and builds leg strength.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands behind your head.
Pull your elbows back and keep your chest up.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

1644.description: A curl you perform in a squat position with a cable. The legs hold you low while the biceps curl.
instructions: Attach a cable handle to the lowest setting on a cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the cable handle with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and arms fully extended.
Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your back straight and knees behind your toes.
As you squat down, curl the cable handle towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause for a moment at the top of the curl, squeezing your biceps.
Slowly lower the cable handle back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将电缆手柄连接到电缆机器上的最低设置。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝上，手臂完全伸展。
将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，膝盖位于脚趾后面。
当你蹲下时，将电缆手柄卷向肩膀，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在弯举的顶部暂停片刻，挤压二头肌。
慢慢地将电缆手柄放回起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1708.description: A partner-assisted stretch lying on your back for the calves. It lengthens the lower leg.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and place your foot flat on the ground.
Using your hands or a towel, gently pull your toes towards your body, feeling a stretch in your calf.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the stretch and repeat on the other leg.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，双腿伸展。
弯曲一侧膝盖，将脚平放在地上。
用手或毛巾轻轻地将脚趾拉向身体，感受小腿的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开拉伸并在另一条腿上重复。

1772.description: A floor push-up variation that lifts the upper body with elbows close to your sides. Works the upper back and posture muscles.
instructions: Start by lying face down on the ground with your legs extended and your hands placed directly under your shoulders.
Engage your core and press through your palms to lift your upper body off the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause at the top for a moment, squeezing your upper back muscles.
Slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，脸朝下躺在地上，双腿伸展，双手直接放在肩膀下方。
收紧核心并用手掌按压，将上半身抬离地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压上背部肌肉。
慢慢地将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1836.description: Bends the neck forward to lengthen the muscles at the back of the neck and upper shoulders.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your shoulders down.
Place both hands lightly behind your head.
Let your elbows drop forward and ease your head toward your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Release your hands and return to neutral.

1900.description: Standing stretch with a bent knee that opens the inner thigh and hip.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide.
Bend one knee and lower into that side.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push the bent knee gently out with your hand.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1964.description: Seated stretch combining pointing the toes down with a turn of the sole inward.
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Curl the toes down and turn the sole gently inward.
Feel the stretch along the top and inner edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2092.description: Pressing the palm against a wall to stretch the forearm flexors.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place one palm on it with the fingers pointing down.
Keep your arm straight.
Slowly turn your body away until you feel the stretch in the forearm.
Keep your fingers flat on the wall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2284.description: A plate-loaded neck exercise that bends the head sideways to the right to strengthen the side neck muscles.
instructions: Set the weight light and position the pad against the right side of your head.
Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the right against the resistance.
Keep the movement small and smooth.
Return slowly to the centre.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.

2348.description: A side-by-side form check for wrist position during a preacher curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Sit at the preacher bench with your upper arms flat on the pad.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your wrists stay neutral and straight rather than bending back or curling in.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2412.description: Seated with a harness attached to a cable behind you, you tuck your chin forward to train the neck flexors.
instructions: Fit the head harness and sit facing away from the cable, attached at head height.
Start with your head tilted slightly back.
Bring your chin toward your chest.
Pause, then return slowly in control.
Keep the load light and your shoulders relaxed.

2732.description: A one arm dumbbell clean followed by a jerk overhead. Trains explosive power from the legs through the shoulder.
instructions: Stand over a dumbbell with feet shoulder width apart and grab it with one hand.
Pull it explosively to your shoulder with a hip drive, dipping slightly under it.
Dip your knees, then drive up and press the dumbbell overhead to a locked arm.
Lower it back to the shoulder and then the floor with control, then switch arms.

2796.description: A dumbbell step-up that finishes with a lunge motion. Builds the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand in front of a step or platform with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Place your right foot on the step, ensuring your entire foot is on the surface.
Push through your right heel and lift your body up onto the step, bringing your left foot up as well.
Once both feet are on the step, lower your left foot back down to the starting position, keeping your right foot on the step.
Repeat the movement, alternating which foot you step up with each time.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站在台阶或平台前，每只手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体两侧。
将右脚放在台阶上，确保整个脚都踩在台阶上。
推动右脚跟，将身体抬起到台阶上，同时将左脚抬起。
双脚踩在台阶上后，将左脚放回起始位置，并将右脚保持在台阶上。
重复该动作，每次交替使用哪只脚。
继续进行所需的重复次数。

2860.description: A controlled move where the legs travel overhead and back, challenging the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs raised.
Roll your legs overhead.
Open them to hip width.
Roll down slowly.
Keep your arms pressing down.

2924.description: A lateral raise performed while lying on your side with a cable. Lying down keeps constant tension on the side delt.
instructions: Lie on your side next to a low cable pulley and grab the handle with your top hand.
Keep your arm straight with a slight bend in the elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side until it is near shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.

2988.description: A deep squat hold and rock that opens the hips and ankles.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width.
Sink into a deep squat, keeping your heels down.
Press your elbows gently against your knees.
Rock side to side and sit tall.
Spend 30-45 seconds there, then stand up.

3116.description: A band pulldown with an underhand grip from an overhead anchor. Builds the lats and biceps.
instructions: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point above your head.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the band with an underhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back to create tension in the band, keeping your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull the band down towards your chest, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, feeling the contraction in your lats.
Slowly release the tension in the band and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在头顶上方坚固的锚点上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住弹力带，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
后退一步，在弹力带上产生张力，保持手臂完全伸展。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将弹力带向下拉向胸部，用肘部引导。
在动作的底部暂停片刻，感受背阔肌的收缩。
慢慢释放带子的张力并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3180.description: A reverse hyperextension on an incline bench that trains the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with hips at the edge.
Hold the sides of the bench.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3244.description: A stretch lengthening the front of the trunk and the abs.
instructions: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press up, lifting your chest.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Look straight ahead and relax.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

3308.description: A classic deadlift lifting a loaded barbell from the floor to hip height. It trains the whole posterior chain and your grip.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and the bar over your mid foot.
Hinge down, grip the bar just outside your legs and brace your core.
Push the floor away and keep the bar close as you stand up.
Lock out with hips and knees extended and shoulders back.
Lower the bar along your legs with a flat back to the floor.

3372.description: Side lunges while whipping the ropes alternately, working legs, shoulders and heart.
instructions: Hold the rope ends and stand with feet together.
Step wide to one side and sit into a side lunge.
Whip the ropes alternately with your arms.
Push back to the middle.
Alternate sides and keep the waves going.

3436.description: A floor extension that lifts arms and legs to strengthen the lower back.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor together.
Squeeze your glutes and lower back.
Hold for 1-2 seconds.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

3500.description: A deep squat hold with gentle movement to open the hips, ankles and lower back.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders, toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down.
Press your elbows against your inner knees with hands together.
Shift gently side to side and hold the bottom.
Keep your chest lifted.
Stand up slowly.

3564.description: A seated stretch that opens the front of the shoulder and lengthens the muscles that lift and pull the arm.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one knee bent and the other leg comfortable.
Place your hands behind you on the floor, fingers pointing away.
Slowly slide your hips forward while keeping your chest tall.
Feel the stretch in the front of your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

3692.description: A goblet squat that touches a box behind you, teaching depth control and sitting back into your hips.
instructions: Place a box or bench behind you and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Push your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your chest up and knees in line with your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand up without rocking.

3948.description: A basic bodyweight squat that builds leg strength and mobility.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand.

4012.description: A rear fly using crossed cables on an incline bench. It targets the rear delts.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench between two cables, holding opposite handles.
Keep elbows slightly bent.
Pull your arms out and back.
Pause.
Return slowly.

4076.description: Single arm band press that travels across the body, working the chest and core.
instructions: Anchor the band behind you and hold the end in one hand.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Press your hand forward and across your body.
Return slowly while resisting rotation.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

4140.description: A one arm overhead band extension to isolate each triceps.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the other end overhead with one hand.
Bend your elbow behind your head.
Extend your arm upward.
Keep your upper arm still.
Switch arms after your set.

4204.description: A nordic curl using a band for assistance.
instructions: Kneel with ankles secured.
Hold the band.
Lower your body forward.
Use the band to help.
Pull back up.
Keep hips extended.

4332.description: A crunch held at the top to keep the abs under tension. Simple and burns quickly.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Hold the top position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Lower down with control.

4396.description: A standing side bend with a kettlebell that trains the obliques and the muscles along the side of the trunk.
instructions: Stand tall, holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Keep your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Bend sideways toward the weighted side without twisting.
Use your obliques to return to upright.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

4524.description: Stepping sideways into a squat while holding a kettlebell at your chest. It works the thighs and hips.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Step out to the side and sit back into a squat.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels and bring your feet together.
Alternate directions or complete all steps on one side before switching.

4588.description: A roundhouse-style kick that swings in an arc into the bag, building hip rotation and power.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Pivot on your standing foot and lift your rear knee out to the side.
Rotate your hips and swing your leg in an arc.
Hit the bag with the top of your foot or shin.
Keep your hands up and your torso steady.
Bring the leg back and switch sides.

4716.description: A chin-up from a low bar with your feet helping, a stepping stone toward full chin-ups.
instructions: Set a bar at about chest height and sit or lie beneath it.
Grip the bar with palms facing you.
Pull your chest toward the bar using your arms and back.
Use your legs only as much as needed.
Lower with control.

4780.description: A seated chin-up using a low bar with an underhand grip. It lets you train the lats and biceps with a reduced load.
instructions: Set a bar at a low height and sit under it.
Grab it with an underhand grip, arms extended.
Extend your legs in front with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

4844.description: A drop from a box followed by a quick vertical jump. It develops reactive power.
instructions: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off and land on both feet.
Rebound immediately into a maximum vertical jump.
Spend as little time on the ground as you can.
Land softly and reset for the next rep.

4908.description: A reverse wrist curl with your forearms resting on a padded bench. It builds the muscles on top of the forearm.
instructions: Kneel by a bench with forearms on it, palms down, wrists over the edge.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your wrists lower gently.
Curl the weights up by extending your wrists.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your forearms still on the bench.

4972.description: A decline sit up followed by a Russian twist at the top. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Sit up toward your knees.
Twist your torso to one side at the top.
Twist to the other side.
Lower slowly to the bench.
Keep your movements controlled.

5036.description: Hamstring curl with your heels on a stability ball. It also challenges balance and the core.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Curl the ball toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Extend your legs again slowly.
Keep your hips high the whole time.

5228.description: A deep, stretched crunch over a Bosu ball. The extra range loads the abs strongly.
instructions: Lie back over a Bosu ball with your lower back supported.
Place your hands beside your head and your feet flat.
Let your torso extend gently over the ball.
Crunch up, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Lower slowly through the full range.

5484.description: One-leg seated calf raise with weight on the knee, working the soleus with extra focus on each side.
instructions: Sit with one forefoot on a raised edge and weight on that knee.
Lower the heel for a full stretch.
Press up onto the ball of your foot as high as possible.
Pause, then lower under control.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

6060.description: A lying pullover with a bottle held in both hands. It stretches and works the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower the bottle in an arc behind your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your sides.
Pull it back over your chest.

6252.description: A face pull on rings. It builds the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Hold the rings and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Pull the rings toward your face.
Flare your elbows out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

6316.description: A quadruped kick that goes up behind you, then crosses over. It hits the glutes from two angles.
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Lift one leg back with a bent knee, sole toward the ceiling.
Lower it, then kick it across behind your other leg.
Alternate basic and cross kicks.
Keep your hips level, then switch legs.

6444.description: Sitting back on your heels in a kneeling pose that stretches your thighs, shins and ankles while keeping your spine tall.
instructions: Kneel on the floor with your knees together.
Point your toes back and sit on your heels.
Rest your hands on your thighs.
Lengthen your spine and breathe slowly.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.

6764.description: A standing forward fold that lengthens the back and the backs of the legs.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Let your arms and head hang down.
Relax your neck and shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Roll up slowly to stand.

7212.description: An air bike crunch with band tension for extra work on the abs and hips.
instructions: Lie on your back, hands behind your head, band around your feet.
Lift your shoulders and bring one knee toward your chest.
Rotate your opposite elbow toward that knee.
Extend the other leg against the band.
Alternate in a pedalling motion.
Keep a steady rhythm.

7276.description: Gorilla row using a weighted bottle in each hand, a handy way to train the back at home.
instructions: Stand wide with a bottle on the floor between your feet and hinge forward.
Keep your back flat and grip a bottle in each hand.
Row one bottle up to your hip while the other stays down.
Lower it, then row with the other side.
Keep your hips steady and alternate sides.

8364.description: An overhead press with a band, training the shoulders and triceps with tension that rises toward the top.
instructions: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep ribs down.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders under control.
Repeat without leaning back.

8620.description: A seated press angled downward to bias the lower chest.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your hands at chest height.
Press them diagonally down and forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly to the chest and repeat.

8876.description: Lying on your back, you pull both knees toward your chest against cable resistance, like a squat in reverse. It works the hip flexors and lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with the cable attached to both ankles or a strap around your feet.
Start with your legs extended and your core braced.
Pull your knees toward your chest in a smooth curl.
Pause at the top without lifting your head.
Lower your legs slowly until they are almost straight.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor throughout.

9068.description: You step off a box and land on both feet to practise soft landings. It builds impact control.
instructions: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off without jumping.
Land on both feet at the same time.
Bend your hips and knees to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second.
Step back up and repeat.

9324.description: Standing on one leg, you extend the straight leg behind you. It strengthens the glutes and trains balance.
instructions: Stand tall holding a support if needed.
Keep your leg straight.
Lift it back behind you.
Stop when your hips begin to tilt.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower it slowly and switch legs.

9516.description: A squat with your heels raised and a clean-width grip, which keeps the torso upright and loads the quads.
instructions: Place your heels on small plates and hold a bar across your upper back with a clean-width grip.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit down into a deep squat with knees tracking over toes.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up through your feet to stand.

10092.description: A barbell squat focused on bracing your core hard through the lift. It builds leg strength and trunk stability.
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Take a deep breath and brace your abs.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your torso tight and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Exhale at the top and reset your brace each rep.

10540.description: Lying on your back with knees bent, you press your foot toward your shin. It targets the front of the lower leg.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Slide one foot under the other for light resistance.
Lift the toes of the lower foot toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

10668.description: A one-arm band row from a kneeling position. It builds the lats and mid back with simple equipment.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and kneel facing it.
Hold the band with one hand and keep your torso upright.
Pull the elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade in.
Return slowly against the tension.
Switch arms after the set.

10732.description: A lateral jump back and forth over a step box. It builds agility and leg power.
instructions: Stand beside a low box with your feet together.
Bend your knees and swing your arms.
Jump sideways over the box.
Land softly on both feet.
Jump back the other way at once.
Keep the pace fast but controlled.

10860.description: A standing cable kick that sweeps the leg out and back. It works the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to one ankle.
Stand side-on to the machine and hold the frame for balance.
Kick the working leg out and slightly behind you, keeping the knee mostly straight.
Pause, then return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Keep your torso still. Finish all reps, then switch legs.

10988.description: Starting kneeling, you jump onto a box holding dumbbells. A very explosive move.
instructions: Kneel in front of a box holding dumbbells at your sides.
Swing your arms and drive up to your feet.
Jump onto the box, landing softly.
Stand tall.
Step down carefully and reset to kneeling.

11436.description: Overhead cable extension with a neutral grip that loads the long head of the triceps through a deep stretch.
instructions: Attach a rope or neutral handle to a low pulley and face away from the stack.
Hold it overhead with elbows bent and pointing forward, one foot slightly ahead.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and your ribs down.
Extend your elbows until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower slowly back to a deep stretch and repeat.

0044.description: Hinge forward at the hips with the bar on your upper back and return by driving the hips forward. Trains the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell resting on your upper back.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge forward at the hips, pushing your buttocks back as if you were trying to touch the wall behind you with your glutes.
Lower your torso until it is parallel to the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position by squeezing your glutes and pushing your hips forward.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，将杠铃放在上背部。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与，臀部向前转动，将臀部向后推，就好像你试图用臀部触碰身后的墙壁一样。
降低躯干直到与地面平行，感觉腿筋被拉伸。
暂停片刻，然后通过挤压臀部并将臀部向前推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0108.description: A standing calf raise with the barbell on the shoulders. Builds the calves.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place a barbell across your upper back.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, using your calves.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
用小腿将脚跟抬离地面，尽可能高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0172.description: An incline cable pushdown with straight arms. Targets the lats.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley cable machine.
Stand facing away from the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean forward slightly and keep your back straight.
Pull the bar down towards your thighs by extending your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将直杆连接到高滑轮电缆机上。
背对机器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，双手距离略宽于肩宽。
稍微向前倾并保持背部挺直。
伸展肘部，将杠铃向下拉向大腿。
在底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0236.description: A standing v-bar cable row with a twist. You pull and rotate the torso a little to work the upper back and the core.
instructions: Attach a v-bar attachment to a cable machine at chest height.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the v-bar with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Take a step back to create tension in the cable.
Keep your back straight and core engaged throughout the exercise.
Pull the v-bar towards your torso by retracting your shoulder blades and bending your elbows.
As you pull, twist your torso to one side, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, feeling the contraction in your upper back.
Slowly release the tension and return to the starting position, untwisting your torso.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, alternating the twisting direction with each rep.
instructionsZh: 将 V 形杆附件连接到胸部高度的缆绳机上。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住 V 形杆，手掌朝下。
后退一步以在电缆中产生张力。
在整个练习过程中保持背部挺直并保持核心参与。
缩回肩胛骨并弯曲肘部，将 V 形杆拉向躯干。
当你拉的时候，将你的躯干扭转到一侧，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，感受上背部的收缩。
慢慢释放紧张并回到起始位置，松开躯干。
重复该动作达到所需的重复次数，每次重复交替扭转方向。

0300.description: A deadlift with a dumbbell in each hand. You hinge and stand to work the glutes, hamstrings and back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body, arms extended downwards.
Bend at your hips and knees, lowering the dumbbells towards the ground while keeping your back straight.
Push through your heels and extend your hips and knees, lifting the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾指向前方。
双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体，手臂向下伸展。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，将哑铃向地面降低，同时保持背部挺直。
脚跟用力，伸展臀部和膝盖，将哑铃举回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0364.description: Forearm supported and palm up, you curl a dumbbell with only the wrist. It builds the muscles on the underside of the forearm.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an underhand grip, resting your forearm on your thigh.
Allow your wrist to extend, letting the dumbbell roll down towards your fingers.
Slowly curl your wrist back up, bringing the dumbbell towards your forearm.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other hand.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上。
一只手握住哑铃，反握，将前臂放在大腿上。
让你的手腕伸展，让哑铃向你的手指方向滚动。
慢慢地向后弯曲手腕，将哑铃拉向前臂。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换另一只手。

0428.description: A standing curl with the upper arms supported on a preacher pad. It isolates the biceps through a strict range.
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Rest the back of your upper arms against the preacher bench or an incline bench, with your elbows slightly bent.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将上臂后部靠在牧师凳或上斜凳上，肘部稍微弯曲。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0492.description: An incline push-up with a drop and explosive rebound. It builds chest power and quickness.
instructions: Find an elevated surface, such as a bench or step, and place your hands shoulder-width apart on the edge.
Step your feet back, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest towards the edge of the surface, bending your elbows and keeping your body aligned.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Jump off the edge of the surface, landing softly with your knees slightly bent.
Repeat the push-up and depth jump for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 找到一个较高的表面，例如长凳或台阶，并将双手与肩同宽放在边缘。
双脚向后退一步，保持身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
将胸部向水面边缘降低，弯曲肘部并保持身体对齐。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
从水面边缘跳下，膝盖稍微弯曲，轻轻落地。
重复俯卧撑和深度跳跃达到所需的重复次数。

0556.description: On hands and knees, you press one bent leg up toward the ceiling. It targets the glutes with a simple, controlled kickback.
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your core tight and your back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent at 90 degrees.
Press the sole of your foot toward the ceiling until your thigh is in line with your back.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control and finish all reps, then switch sides.

0620.description: Lying on a flat bench, you raise and lower straight legs. Works the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on a flat bench with your back pressed against it.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Keep your legs straight and together, and lift them up towards the ceiling.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在平坦的长凳上，背部紧贴长凳。
将双手放在臀部下方以获得支撑。
保持双腿伸直并拢，然后将它们抬向天花板。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0684.description: A running style move that gets your heart rate up. Keep a steady pace for as long as you like.
instructions: Start by standing upright with your feet hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your upper body relaxed.
Begin jogging in place, lifting your knees up towards your chest and landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Maintain a steady pace and continue jogging for the desired duration or distance.
Remember to breathe deeply and maintain good posture throughout the exercise.
instructionsZh: 首先站直，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
启动你的核心并保持上半身放松。
开始原地慢跑，将膝盖抬向胸部，然后轻轻落在脚掌上。
保持稳定的步伐并继续慢跑所需的时间或距离。
记住在整个练习过程中深呼吸并保持良好的姿势。

0748.description: Lying on a bench, you press a smith machine bar up from your chest. Works the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to chest level.
Lie flat on the bench with your feet firmly planted on the ground.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and lower it towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment when the bar touches your chest.
Push the bar back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机杆的高度调整至胸部水平。
平躺在长凳上，双脚牢牢踩在地上。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其向胸部降低，保持肘部内收。
当杠铃接触到你的胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0812.description: A bench dip with the legs extended on the floor or a bench, lowering and pressing the body up. It trains the triceps.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Walk your feet forward, sliding your butt off the bench, and straighten your arms.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳边缘，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
双脚向前走，将臀部滑离长凳，然后伸直手臂。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
推动手掌以伸直手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
